'''Stormcaller''' was the name of a [[Hovertank/Legends|Hovertank]] deployed during the [[Battle of Denova]]. The [[Dread Masters]] took control of both [[Warstalkers/Legends|Warstalkers]] led by [[Kephess]] and a significant number of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] force. Stormcaller and another tank named [[Firebrand (tank)|Firebrand]] were piloted by two female pilots under the influence of the Dread Masters and engaged an operation group making its way to [[Kephess's Redoubt]]. In a fierce battle, both hovertanks were destroyed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stormcaller appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a boss during the "Explosive Conflict" operation.<ref name="SWTOR" />
